caption: The Bell-state circuit of the worked example, read left to right: H on q0, then CNOT q0→q1, then measurement. The two measured bits always agree, so only 00 and 11 appear.

spec.title: Bell-state circuit
spec.aria: A left-to-right pipeline starting from two qubits in state 00, applying H to the first qubit, then CNOT from the first to the second qubit, then measurement.
